notes: Artificial Analysis Coding Agents Index read 2026-10-13: 39 agent records (agent harness plus model) parsed from the embedded page payload; roster rows stored for Muse Code with Muse Wonder Full, Muse Wonder and Muse Spark 1.3, Claude Code with Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 (five efforts), Fable 5.1 and Haiku 5.5 (five efforts), Codex with GPT-6.1 Sol (five efforts) and GPT-6 Astra. The index is the equal-weight mean of three evaluations run by AA: DeepSWE v1.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA and Terminal-Bench v4. Each agent runs in its own harness, so rows are comparable:false and harness-tagged; the Terminal-Bench v4 reading here is a different run from the AA Intelligence Index Terminal-Bench 4.0 rows. Effort labels are those in AA's display label. AA marks which configuration is its default; non-default efforts exist only for Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol. Recheck on or after 2026-10-20.

claims.statement: AA Coding Agents Index (equal-weight mean of DeepSWE v1.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA and Terminal-Bench v4, each agent in its own harness): Claude Code with Sonnet 5.5 (max) 68.4, Muse Code with Muse Wonder Full (max) 68.0, Claude Code with Opus 5.5 (max) 66.0, Muse Code with Muse Wonder (max) 63.5, Muse Code with Muse Spark 1.3 (max) 54.3. The AA article gives 68 / 68 / 66 / 63 / 54 for the same rows. Muse Code with Muse Wonder Full has no cost per task (no per-token price); Muse Wonder (max) costs $8.05 per task against $14.19 for Claude Code Sonnet 5.5 (max) and $13.04 for Opus 5.5 (max).
claims.implication: Agent harness and model are confounded on this board; a Muse Code row measures Muse Code plus the model. AA labels Muse Wonder rows max only.

claims.statement: DeepSWE v1.1 on the AA Coding Agents run (not the Datacurve board): Muse Wonder Full (max) 77.0%, Muse Wonder (max) 75.8%, Sonnet 5.5 (max) 72.0%, Opus 5.5 (max) 68.4%, GPT-6.1 Sol (xhigh, AA default) 73.2%, GPT-6 Astra (max) 67.6%, Fable 5.1 (max, with fallback) 64.3%. Gemini 4 Argon (high, Antigravity CLI; not a catalog model) is 78.8%, above Muse Wonder Full. Meta's launch table on https://dev.meta.ai/models/muse-wonder lists DeepSWE 1.1 as Muse Wonder Full 79.0, Muse Wonder 78.8, Fable 5.1 67.4, GPT-6 Astra 74.1, Opus 5.5 74.2, and the same page says Muse Wonder Full 'tops agentic and coding benchmarks, including DeepSWE and SWE-Marathon in independent third-party runs'.
claims.implication: CONFLICT, not reconciled: AA's independent DeepSWE v1.1 run has Muse Wonder Full below Gemini 4 Argon and 2.0 points under Meta's own figure (Muse Wonder 3.0 under), and Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra are 3.1 to 6.5 points lower than in Meta's table. The public Datacurve DeepSWE board has no Muse Wonder row (see the coverage file). The claim 'tops DeepSWE' holds among catalog models on AA's run, not on Meta's table or against Argon.

claims.statement: AA's Coding Agents Index host model slugs for the Muse Wonder rows are 'meta_straw-110_evals_ext_max' (Muse Wonder Full) and 'meta_restful-rf120_evals_ext_max' (Muse Wonder); Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 rows use 'private-anthropic_..._eap_*' slugs. These are non-public host names. AA does not say on the page whether the runs used a pre-release or evaluation deployment; the slugs suggest an external-evaluation build but this is an inference, not an AA statement.
claims.implication: Treat the Coding Agents rows as launch-day reads from a non-public host id. Recheck on or after 2026-10-20.
